messages:
marco: Heads-up — we have the tf apply scheduled for 17:00 UTC in the release window. small networking + iam change that touches peering and a couple service accounts. I expect a short stall risk from provider API throttling.
shan: thanks. is this the change that bumped the provider version? any pinning required?
marco: yes, provider bumped to 4.12.0 in the branch. plan looked clean locally. i added a pin in `modules/network/provider.tf` but we should consider a 30m runway if we hit 429s.
dev-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `prod/infra` tf-apply at 17:00 UTC. Canary in us-west-2 -> staggered to other regions. If any step fails, auto-rollback disabled (manual rollback).
anya: can we add a brief preflight that runs `terraform plan -out=plan.tf` and verifies no drift for the peering resources? i'd like a quick diff against last release.
marco: yeah i'm going to run an autoscan at 16:30 and post the plan snippet. also will attach release notes blurb for platform.
sre_oncall: FYI, if peering attach hangs we need the network-evac playbook. I'll be on standby. link: https://wiki.redwood/ops/network-evac
devops: double-checking IAM SA changes: any new roles? we added read-only role for the metrics exporter. keep service account creation guarded by `count = var.enable_metrics ? 1 : 0` so we can toggle.
shan: ok. if apply stalls on `aws_iam_role` creation we should abort and rollback to last statefile. who will run the rollback?
marco: i'll coordinate rollback with devops. plan for manual rollback: restore state from S3 version before apply and run a targeted apply to remove partial resources.
anya: include release notes: "infra: enable metrics exporter SA behind feature flag; network: minor peering tag normalization" — i'll add to the release PR.
sre_oncall: suggested cutoff: if any step > 10min waiting on provider API, call timeout and abort. we don't want half-attached peerings.
dev-deploy-bot: Action items: 1) marco run preflight plan at 16:30 and paste output. 2) devops hold rollback creds ready. 3) sre_oncall monitor. 4) anya add release note fragment. 5) shan confirm provider pin in branch.
marco: preflight plan done — small diff, no replacements. snippet: ```
# aws_vpc_peering_connection.example
  ~ peer_owner_id: "123456789012" -> "123456789012"
  ~ tags.%: "2" -> "3"  # forces tag update only
```
shan: confirmed provider pin `required_providers { aws = { version = "~> 4.12.0" } }` in branch. ack from me.
devops: creds ready and a snapshot of state made at 16:55 (s3://redwood-tfstate/prod/backup/6112233445).
sre_oncall: i'll set a pager watch at 16:50. if anything odd, i'll escalate.
marco: thanks all. we'll proceed at 17:00 UTC, staggered canary then full. i'll update this thread when canary completes. :thumbsup:
dev-deploy-bot: deploy started: canary us-west-2 -> monitoring.
marco: canary completed, no errors, token rate peaked but within retry window. proceeding to us-east-1.
anya: small note — i updated release notes with the SA toggle example. merging PR after deploy completes.
marco: full rollout done at 17:09. no rollbacks required. closing thread. :party:
